title: Taylor
creator: CrossFit
description: Four rounds of a 400 m run and 5 burpee muscle-ups, in a vest, for time. Honours U.S. Army Spc. David Wayne Taylor, 82nd Airborne, killed in an accident at an ammunition supply point in Kandahar in 2012. Only 20 muscle-ups, so this is fast if you have them.
